probe [options]

Commands:
  probe sub  a subcommand

Options:
      --version                 Show version number                    [boolean]
  -f, --force                   skip confirmation prompts              [boolean]
  -n, --limit                   maximum number of results to return, a
                                deliberately long description so yargs has to
                                wrap it onto continuation lines         [number]
      --dry-run                 print what would change                [boolean]
  -o, --output, --out           write output here                       [string]
      --print-config-dir, --cd  multi-letter alias                     [boolean]
      --help                    Show help                              [boolean]
